svg.text: SignalSafe: detecting harmful content related to sexual violence
PeaceTech Hackathon, ICRC challenge, Ukraine: multi-platform collection, AI triage, duplicate filter, community and trained volunteer reports, human review by the ICRC
Public posts only: text, metadata, hashes
Search terms, or one post by URL
Downloaded only for the AI judge,
a paid Apify plan, or the ICRC
Our model, on our own GPU
The AI proposes, a human decides
AI labels and score, human decision, tags and copies: one record per content group. Analysis dashboard by tag, source and platform.
Stored in the database, never in git. Restricted items are never exported.
No sexual-violence images or videos are stored or annotated: media is judged in a temporary folder, then deleted; only hashes and links are kept. Anything that may involve a child
and sexual content is restricted: never shown, never sent to reviewers, never exported (escalation channel to ICRC legal, NCMEC and IWF still to be connected). Same rules for all
sides. The AI proposes, an ICRC human decides: no automatic action. Each collector follows its platform's terms of service.
